summary: Sun Life Financial Inc. via Form 6-K announced the completion of its acquisition of Bell Partners, a U.S. multifamily real estate investment manager and property management firm. Sun Life acquired a 100% interest for a purchase price of US$350 million, with approximately 80% paid in Sun Life common shares and the remainder presumably in cash. Bell Partners will continue to operate as a distinct, vertically integrated business under BGO with its current leadership. The deal expands Sun Life's asset management capabilities in the resilient U.S. multifamily sector. As the transaction is already closed, no further regulatory or shareholder action is required; the risk-arb angle is moot.
